style: Modern editorial book illustration, like illustrations for a reading app's year-in-review: flat organic shapes with subtle shading, visible fine grain and risograph-like texture, muted pastel palette (lavender, sage green, peach, mustard, terracotta, soft navy, cream). Simple stylized people with calm closed eyes, small noses and simple features, diverse appearance. Calm everyday mood, not festive, no Christmas or New Year elements, no snow. Vertical 2:3 composition. The top 40% of the image is a calm plain background (sky, wall or soft color field) with no objects, so text can be placed there. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks. Hands are hidden or very simplified.

scenes.main: A young woman and a young man reading together on a picnic blanket on a grassy hill under a big tree: she lies on her stomach reading a book, he sits leaning against the tree trunk reading his own book, several books scattered around, a teapot and cups on the blanket, a sleepy cat curled next to her, soft afternoon light.
scenes.book: A giant open book standing upright on a quiet meadow like a doorway, warm light pouring out of its pages, a small person walking towards it along a path, a few birds in the sky.
scenes.pages: A young man with short hair and a beard sitting cross-legged on top of a very tall, slightly wobbly tower of colorful books that rises above the rooftops of a small city, reading calmly, a ladder leaning against the tower, soft clouds around.
scenes.month: A young woman curled up on a wide windowsill, a closed book resting on her knees, she is turned towards the window and dreamily looking out at the rain, potted plants and a stack of books on the sill, a cat sleeping at her feet, a cozy room with a lamp.
scenes.type: A young man and a young woman sitting face to face in a small wooden rowing boat drifting on a calm lake at golden hour, talking and smiling at each other, not reading; closed books stacked in the boat between them, an oar resting on the side, reeds and distant hills, reflections on the water.

stat.p: A cozy reading nook seen from the side: a young woman sitting in a deep armchair with a book, next to her a tall wooden bookshelf, a small round side table with a cup of tea and a little stack of books, a floor lamp with warm light, a potted plant, a sleeping cat on a cushion. Around the shelf float a few small decorative golden elements: a ribbon medal, a small star and a tiny trophy, like reading achievements.
stat.style: Modern editorial book illustration for a reading app, flat organic shapes with subtle shading, visible fine grain and risograph-like texture, muted warm palette (mustard, terracotta, sage green, soft navy, cream, lavender) on a deep warm dark-brown background. Simple stylized person with calm closed eyes. Wide horizontal banner composition: all objects and the person are in the RIGHT 55% of the image, the LEFT 45% is a calm plain dark background with nothing in it, so text can be placed there. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks. Hands hidden or very simplified.

logo1.p:
App icon and logo for «Нора» - a cozy Russian book app ("burrow", a night library by candlelight). Start from the current logo: four nested rounded arches like the entrance to a burrow or a doorway, colors from outside in: plum #8A4C86, coral #D46A66, apricot #F4A766, glowing cream #FFF4D2 in the center, on a deep aubergine-night background (#2E2150 to #0B0812). In the current version the arches run off the bottom edge - fix that: the whole mark must sit fully inside the square, optically centered, with generous even margins.

Variant 1: the four arches closed at the bottom by a soft horizontal floor line, the mark centered in the upper two thirds; below it the word «Нора» in an elegant high-contrast Cyrillic serif (like Cormorant Garamond), warm cream color.
logo1.style: Flat vector app icon, square 1:1, clean geometric shapes, smooth gradients, no 3D, no photorealism, no mockup, no frame, no extra words or letters except the word specified. If the word «Нора» is drawn, spell it exactly in Russian Cyrillic: Н-о-р-а, one word, elegant, well kerned, centered.

statsd1.p: Award-winning editorial graphic design for the LAST slide of a reading app's year-in-books Instagram Story recap («Нора»). Same family as the rest of the series: lavender-lilac sky (#C9B8E0) to soft peach (#F2D3C2), modern flat editorial illustration with simple stylized people with calm faces, fine grain. Contemporary and playful, NOT vintage, no paper texture, no ribbons or banners. The eye must catch and keep exploring: asymmetric layout, mixed scales, overlapping elements, illustration interacting with the typography, slight rotations, hand-drawn doodle arrows and underlines with short handwritten notes. Each of the five stats must look completely different from the others - never a grid of equal boxes. Text in Russian, spelled exactly: headline «Мой 2026 в цифрах» (handwritten brush script, plum #5A2F66); hero «2 000» + «страниц прочитано» (the biggest thing, very bold wide geometric sans like Unbounded, ink #2B2440); «5 книг за год»; «Июль - самый читающий месяц»; «любимый жанр - современная проза»; «средняя оценка 5,0 ★»; «мой читательский тип - Наблюдатель за людьми»; small «nora-books.ru» in a cream pill at the bottom. Palette only: lavender, lilac, peach, cream #FFFBF4, plum #5A2F66, terracotta #8E3F2E, ink #2B2440, sage green. Concept: a girl in a cozy sweater sits on top of the giant «2 000» number reading a book, her legs hanging over the zero; a calico cat curls inside the other zero. «5 книг» is a little stack of five colorful books with the number on the spine; «Июль» is a tilted torn calendar sheet; the genre is written on a book cover lying at an angle; «5,0 ★» is a round sticker badge; the reader type is a handwritten note with a doodle arrow pointing at the girl.
statsd1.style: Contemporary editorial poster design, crisp, playful, print quality, subtle grain.

statsbg.p: Background artwork for the last slide of a reading app's year-in-books Instagram Story. It must contain ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO letters, NO numbers, NO words anywhere - all empty surfaces stay blank, text will be added later by the app. Modern zine-style collage on a saturated lavender sky (#B7A2DA at the top, warm peach #F4C9AE at the bottom), same rich colors as the series: lavender, warm peach, terracotta #B4553F, mustard yellow #E3B04B, sage green #8FA77E, deep plum #5A2F66, cream. Layout from top to bottom: the top 15% is plain sky (headline goes there, keep it empty). Upper left: a large blank flat peach circle, about 45% of the width, empty inside (a big number goes there). Upper right, overlapping the circle edge: a young woman in a cream sweater and terracotta trousers sitting on a stack of three books, reading an open book, calm closed eyes, simple features. Middle left: a small stack of four colorful books lying sideways next to a blank cream square paper card tilted slightly left. Middle right: a blank tear-off calendar leaf with a spiral top, tilted slightly right, empty face. Lower left: a big blank mustard-yellow five-pointed star sticker, tilted; and below it a plum book lying at an angle with a blank cream label on its cover. Lower right: a polaroid photo tilted right showing a small illustrated woman looking through binoculars at hills, with a blank white strip at the bottom of the polaroid. Between the objects: a few hand-drawn dashed arrows and small sprigs of leaves, little sparkles. Bottom center: an empty cream pill shape. Generous spacing between objects, nothing overlaps the blank areas.
statsbg.style: Modern flat editorial illustration with subtle shading, visible fine grain and risograph-like texture, saturated warm palette (not pale), crisp shapes, simple stylized people with calm closed eyes. Vertical 2:3. No text at all.

statsbg2.p: Background artwork for the last slide of a reading app's year-in-books Instagram Story. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO letters, NO numbers anywhere - every blank surface stays empty, text is added later. NO arrows, NO dashed lines. Modern zine-style collage on a saturated lavender sky (#B7A2DA at the top) fading to warm peach (#F4C9AE) at the bottom. Rich colors: lavender, warm peach, terracotta #B4553F, mustard #E3B04B, sage green #8FA77E, deep plum #5A2F66, cream. Every element must be unique - no repeated decorations, no two similar plants, only ONE stack of books in the whole picture. Layout top to bottom: top 15% plain sky, empty. Upper area: a wide horizontal torn-paper strip in warm peach, about 75% of the width and only about 13% of the height, slightly tilted, blank (a big number goes on it); the strip is placed upper left and its right end tucks under the illustration. Upper right: a young woman in a cream sweater and terracotta trousers sitting on a stack of three books, reading, calm closed eyes. Middle left: a blank cream square paper card tilted slightly left, with a small steaming teacup beside it (no books here). Middle right: a blank tear-off calendar leaf with a spiral top, tilted slightly right. Lower left: a LARGE blank mustard five-pointed star sticker, wide enough to hold two short lines of text inside. Below it: a plum book lying at an angle with a LARGE blank cream rectangular label covering most of its cover. Lower right: a polaroid photo tilted right showing a small woman looking through binoculars at hills, with a wide blank white strip at the bottom. Decorations, each different and used once: one sage sprig on the left, one small bunch of lavender flowers on the right, a cluster of tiny sparkles near the top, a sleeping calico cat near the bottom right corner. Bottom center: an empty cream pill shape. Generous spacing, nothing covers the blank areas.
statsbg2.style: Modern flat editorial illustration with subtle shading, visible fine grain and risograph-like texture, saturated warm palette (not pale), crisp shapes, simple stylized people with calm closed eyes. Vertical 2:3. No text at all.
